• Skincare basics: a simple morning and evening routine

• Hair, beard and brows: grooming that suits your face
• Photo presence: better light and camera angles

Start with a photo and your goals. ZELGI turns your information into appearance insights, recommendations, and a structured 30-day plan tailored to you.

Explore a new perspective on your appearance.

Using your Day 1 photo and the goals you provide, ZELGI analyzes visible appearance characteristics and offers personalized insights into:

• Hairstyles and hair presentation
• Grooming and personal care
• Skin appearance
• Personal style and overall presentation

AI-generated previews are illustrative and may differ from real-world results.

• Follow daily grooming and appearance-related actions
• Build consistent personal care habits
